title: Sandustry Water Basics — Wet Sand, Floods, Pipes & Early Fluids
description: Sandustry water and fluid basics for Early Access: why wet sand matters, flood habits, pipe discipline, FAQ, and official sources.
note: Exact fluid rules, heat interactions, and building unlocks change in EA. Cross-check the official wiki and tooltips for current mechanics.

paragraphs: Steam and community chatter both treat fluids as part of the fantasy — wet sand, pumps, and pipes sit next to conveyors in the automation story.
The marketed early loop literally involves refining wet sand toward gold. Moisture is not a late-game curiosity.
Digging without watching water can bury machines, starve refiners that expect wet input, or create unreachable flooded pockets.

sections.h2: Read the dig face like a risk map
paragraphs: Before placing fragile logistics, scan for unexpected moisture migration.
A beautiful belt through a future flood channel is a rebuild waiting to happen.
If you must dig near water, leave a dry buffer zone around key refiners and junctions.
Learn one pump and pipe path before branching a full fluid network.
Keep fluid lines visually separate from belt spaghetti when you can.
When stuck, pause digging and fix fluid routing — more sand rarely fixes a flooded belt.
Treat fluid overflows with the same seriousness as belt overflows: intentional sinks beat mystery puddles.

sections.h2: How fluids interact with automation thinking
paragraphs: A “dry” logistics plan can fail because the refine recipe expects wet material — or because water displaced your sorted lanes.
Filters and dumps still matter when fluids are involved; wet chaos plus unsorted belts is a double clog.
After any major fluid change, re-watch the refine input junction for thirty seconds.

sections.h2: Verify in-game and on official pages
paragraphs: Building names, unlock order, and heat interactions belong to the current patch.
Use the Hooded Horse Sandustry wiki and Steam news for authoritative details.
Then return to Automation Tips and the Beginner Guide for layout habits that still apply.

faq.a: Steam marketing highlights refining wet sand toward gold. Treat that as the intended early fantasy, and confirm steps in your build / official wiki.

faq.q: Should I pipe everything on day one?
faq.a: No. Get one correct wet path working, then expand. Fluid mazes are hard to debug.

faq.q: My base flooded — dig more exits?
faq.a: Stabilize routing and protect machines first. Extra holes can spread the flood.
